id: title:Gilbert09:add destination health and auto pause

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse destination status tracking, error recording, and recovery controls to the warehouse ingestion subsystem.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: P1.F13.H1 and P1.F15.H1 add database fields and status choices to track warehouse delivery health and failures; P1.F16.H3 and P1.F27.H1 show implementation and tests for resuming paused destinations and clearing failure states. This establishes a reliability and recovery mechanism for warehouse ingestion. Tier 3,
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the complete implementation of helper functions and permission checks, and P1.F27.H2 and P1.F28.H1 are tests without corresponding implementation, so the full recovery and access control behavior is not demonstrated. No tier assignment is made; the score is not assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test class and several parametrized tests, including a new test for the scenario where every destination is paused, and a new assertion for warehouse status and latest_error.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds checks for warehouse destination status and latest_error in warehouse destination API responses.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test and generated API schema changes. No implementation, configuration, or runtime behavior changes are supplied, so tier and score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a parameterized test for resuming a paused destination and a test for access control when resuming.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that resuming a destination clears its paused status and resets consecutive_configuration_failures to 0, while also asserting that the destination link and schema link become enabled. This could help prevent a user from accidentally leaving a warehouse destination in a failed state, but the implementation is not supplied.

observations.behavior: Adds a test class for access control when resuming a destination, asserting that an editor without permission cannot resume a destination.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that resuming a destination requires editor access. This could help prevent unauthorized users from resuming warehouse destinations, but the implementation is not supplied.
Checks that an empty destination list raises NoActiveDestinationsError. This could help prevent warehouse ingestion from failing silently, but the implementation is not supplied.
